# Sign of the Product of an Array.

@example The product is -210: three of the factors are negative.
[3,-7,2,-1,-5]
=> -1

@example Two negative factors: the product is 216.
[-4,-9,6]
=> 1

@example One factor is 0, so the product is 0, whatever the rest.
[8,-2,0,-100]
=> 0

# One element: negative, zero, positive.
[-100]
=> -1

[0]
=> 0

[1]
=> 1

# No negatives at all.
[5,1,100,2,37]
=> 1

# A zero first wins over three negatives.
[0,-3,-5,-7]
=> 0

# A zero last wins over three negatives.
[-2,-2,-2,0]
=> 0

# All negative: an even count gives 1, an odd count -1.
[-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1]
=> 1

[-100,-100,-100]
=> -1

# 32 factors of -2: the product 2^32 is 0 in a 32-bit int.
[-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2,-2]
=> 1

# Powers of two whose product, 2^66, is 0 in 64 bits; 5 negatives.
[64,-64,64,-64,64,-64,64,-64,64,-64,64]
=> -1

# 300 factors of +-100 make a double overflow to infinity; then a zero.
[-100,100,-100,100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,100,-100,100,100,-100,100,100,100,-100,100,100,100,-100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,100,-100,100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,100,-100,100,100,100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,-100,100,100,100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,100,100,100,100,100,100,100,100,-100,100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,100,-100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,100,100,100,100,-100,100,100,-100,100,100,100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,100,100,-100,-100,100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,100,100,-100,-100,100,100,100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,100,100,100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,100,100,100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,100,-100,100,-100,-100,100,100,-100,-100,-100,-100,0,7]
=> 0

# The longest array, 1000 factors of -100: 1000 negatives is even.
[-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100,-100 # 151 negatives among 161 factors, no zero: the count is odd. Kept in a
# signed char, a counter of negatives wraps past 127 to -105, and
# -105 % 2 is -1, not 1.
[-1,-38,-75,-12,-49,66,-23,-60,-97,-34,-71,-8,-45,-82,-19,-56,-93,-30,-67,-4,-41,-78,87,-52,-89,-26,-63,-100,-37,-74,-11,-48,-85,-22,-59,-96,-33,-70,-7,8,-81,-18,-55,-92,-29,-66,-3,-40,-77,-14,-51,-88,-25,-62,-99,-36,29,-10,-47,-84,-21,-58,-95,-32,-69,-6,-43,-80,-17,-54,-91,-28,-65,50,-39,-76,-13,-50,-87,-24,-61,-98,-35,-72,-9,-46,-83,-20,-57,-94,71,-68,-5,-42,-79,-16,-53,-90,-27,-64,-1,-38,-75,-12,-49,-86,-23,92,-97,-34,-71,-8,-45,-82,-19,-56,-93,-30,-67,-4,-41,-78,-15,-52,13,-26,-63,-100,-37,-74,-11,-48,-85,-22,-59,-96,-33,-70,-7,-44,-81,34,-55,-92,-29,-66,-3,-40,-77,-14,-51,-88,-25,-62,-99,-36,-73,-10,55,-84,-21]
=> -1

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[-3,2,0,3,3,0,-1]
=> 0

@gen 2 small
[-3,-2,-3,-1,2]
=> 1

@gen 3 small
[2,3,-3,2,1,-3,-2,-1]
=> 1

@gen 4 small
[3,-3,-1,2]
=> 1

@gen 5 small
[-2,-1,2,-1,-1,-2]
=> -1

@gen 6 small
[2,-3]
=> -1
